name: 38496-probrejectspec-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine; the EAGLE draft head runs inside the target's worker process, so there is no second engine.
architecture: TARGET: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, vocab 128256, max_position_embeddings 8192, bf16, 8.03B params. DRAFT: model_type eagle, one decoder layer over hidden 4096, same vocab, max_position_embeddings 2048; it loads in the target's dtype.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=256, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 2560 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm json_file, configs/data/mtbench-firstturn-80x5.jsonl -- 400 rows, the 80 MT-Bench first-turn prompts (question_id 81-160, all eight categories) cycled five times, each row carrying output_tokens_count 256. Raw prompt tokens pre-chat-template: mean 65.7, min 12, p50 38, p90 179, max 349; request_format default-template wraps each row as a user message and applies the model's chat template. temperature 1.0, ignore_eos true, and spec.seed 38496 fixes the request sequence (a data seed, not a vLLM seed -- none is set).
purpose: A general-purpose chat assistant with draft-model acceleration serving 256 concurrent users short prompts and 256-token replies on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine: commit ad3304425b4c3622a3c10f57699d740e6f5f7cf3 (`git describe --tags` =
# v0.19.1rc0-87-gad3304425b4c). Interpreter and hardware: configs/env.yaml, which is this
# machine's answer and is NOT portable.
#
# WHICH MODEL RUNNER RUNS IS NOT AN ENGINE ARGUMENT. This setup is declared on vLLM's V2 model
# runner, selected at this commit by VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1 and by nothing in this file; it
# is carried in configs/tuned.yaml under `apply:`. Unset, the engine serves the same request set
# through a different runner, without error.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct

# The draft is `abhigoyal/EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B-vllm` with ONE tensor removed, and it has to
# be: that repo ships an `lm_head.weight`, and `EagleLlamaForCausalLM` at this commit never
# allocates an lm_head (llama_eagle.py:164-182 -- it expects to be handed the target's), so the
# stock repo aborts at weight load with
#   ValueError: There is no module or parameter named 'lm_head' in EagleLlamaForCausalLM
# The removal is numerically exact, not an approximation: the repo's lm_head.weight is
# BYTE-IDENTICAL to the target's (sha256 6f14b339532db00e..., BF16 [128256, 4096], compared
# against NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct model-00004-of-00004.safetensors). With it
# absent, `has_own_lm_head` stays False (interfaces.py:1257) and eagle/utils.py:44-49 binds
# eagle_model.lm_head = target_model.lm_head -- the same numbers reached by the intended path.
# Every other tensor in the local copy was verified byte-for-byte against the hub file. The path
# is local because the modified copy cannot be published.
speculative-config: {"method": "eagle", "model": "${SYSAGENT_DATA}/models/EAGLE-LLaMA3-Instruct-8B-vllm-sharedhead", "num_speculative_tokens": 3, "max_model_len": 2048, "rejection_sample_method": "probabilistic"}

# The draft checkpoint's own max_position_embeddings is 2048, so this ceiling is the draft's
# rather than ours. The worst request here is 349 raw prompt tokens plus 256 generated.
max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
data-parallel-size: 1

# The engine's default at this commit is ON. Off here because the request file is 80 distinct
# prompts cycled past its own length: with caching on, later passes prefill out of cache and the
# headline rate becomes a function of cache residency rather than of the engine.
enable-prefix-caching: false

# `auto` would resolve bf16 off the target's config.json; the draft's own config says float16 but
# it inherits the target's dtype. Pinned so neither can drift.
dtype: bfloat16

# Equal to `streams` in scenario.json, not above it: the load is a closed loop at exactly 256, so
# a cap of 256 admits every request that can ever be in flight and never binds.
max-num-seqs: 256

# A verification step offers 256 x (K+1) = 1024 tokens to the target, comfortably under this.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# The engine's own default, written down so the pool sizes identically run to run.
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
